name: Tab Controller
description: Hide rarely-used DM panel tabs AND individual collapsible sub-sections inside the Session tab (Session Info, Connected Players, Quick Dice Reference, AI Integration). Hidden tabs stay reachable via the Open button; hidden sub-sections re-appear only by re-ticking them. Map / Token library / Token list / Session itself are protected. The plugin's own panel is collapsible too.
author: TableTop Forge
